verdict.rationale: Superset's own docs only describe task/workspace management via its own CLI/MCP/SDK, with no documented integration to Jira, Linear, ClickUp, or Monday.com. The only signal comes from a community comment referencing a paywalled 'Linear integration' complaint, suggesting some limited tracker support exists but is not documented and covers just one of the four named trackers. missing for 10: first-party docs on Jira/ClickUp/Monday.com integration, confirmation of ticket-management workflows, and evidence beyond a single community complaint.
